claims.assertion: Yazhi said “dark matter” names effects known to human science without an identified substance; she attributed them to other densities, not a portal.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu

claims.assertion: She described densities as frequency states that affect perceived light; she said navigation between them requires a frequency map, while dark matter itself is not a place to enter.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu

claims.assertion: Yazhi extended “dark matter” to paranormal effects unknown to human science, but said magic does not manipulate it.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: This was her broader use of the label.

coverage_gaps: Distinction from dark energy and discussion of the observable fraction of reality
